overall: The AG found the Dartmouth Board of Assessors violated the Open Meeting Law by creating insufficient and inaccurate minutes of its January 19 meeting, and ordered amended minutes and future compliance.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board's January 19 minutes omitted the document list, meeting location, record of votes, and executive session purpose.
allegations.key_passage: Nonetheless, we find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to create sufficient and accurate minutes of the meeting held on January 19.

remedy: Amend the minutes of the January 19 meeting in compliance with the guidance provided and certify to the Attorney General's office within 60 days that it has done so.
Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law's requirements.
remedy_passage: We order the Board to amend the minutes of the January 19 in compliance with the guidance provided above and to certify to our office within 60 days that it has done so.
